title: I.R Management Platform
description: A multi-application investor-relations platform that pairs a shared interface language with dense operational data.
role: Built reusable UI patterns and complex data visualizations
challenge: Keep independent sub-apps consistent and usable
decision: Anchor implementation in the company design system

title: inUI Library
description: An internal UI library that gives product teams a cohesive foundation for building application interfaces.
role: Co-author of the shared UI library
challenge: Improve development efficiency without fragmenting the experience
decision: Create reusable patterns for cross-application use

title: Investor Onboarding Portal
description: An investor registration and document-management platform that brings KYC and compliance into a single onboarding flow.
role: Co-developer of the registration and document-management platform
decision: Unify registration, documents, KYC, and compliance

title: Credit Healing UI Library
description: A reusable component collection and design-system foundation for internal and client-facing applications.
role: Contributor to the component collection and design-system elements
challenge: Serve different application contexts without losing ease of use
decision: Combine reusable components with distinctive design-system elements

title: Covid News Dashboard
description: An interactive dashboard for following COVID-19 statistics through real-time regional views.
challenge: Turn multiple data sources into real-time, regional COVID-19 breakdowns
decision: Aggregate multiple APIs and render them with amCharts 4

title: Social News Dashboard
description: A social-news aggregator that keeps defined trending topics visible without requiring visitor input.
role: Built the continuously updating news interface
challenge: Surface up-to-date social trends with no user interaction required
decision: Continuously update and auto-scroll the defined trending topics

title: Material Start Page
description: My first frontend project: a responsive start page built from the ground up with Material Design principles.
role: Sole author — my first frontend project
challenge: Build every component from scratch on Material Design principles, responsive throughout
decision: Hand-built all components with no UI framework
